svg.title: MoGe-2, D2-VFormer and R2-EFormer pipeline diagram
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the supplied figure. Base frames: f01 contains T-frame surround-view images and time labels; f02 contains the top pipeline with image encoder, D2-VFormer, voxel cube, R2-EFormer, OCC decoder and occupancy prediction; f03 contains the Depth Cues module with MoGe-2, depth features, surround-view depth images, pseudo point cloud, depth occupancy grid and back-projection/voxelization arrows; f04 contains D2-VFormer with image features, DepthNet/ContextNet, voxel pooling/encoder, sparse voxel features and depth-guided non-empty voxel refinement/backward projection densification; f05 contains R2-EFormer with occupancy semantic feature, recursion block and full-region voxel feature. The composition is horizontally organized: image/depth cues on the left, D2-VFormer in the center, R2-EFormer on the right, with orthogonal and triangular arrows connecting stages.
